key_idea: Look at which sides of the hole have a road coming in.
steps: A road comes down into the middle of the top side of the gray hole.
Another road comes in from the left, into the middle of the left side.
The right side and bottom side are the edge of the map, so no road goes there.
Piece C has a corner road. Turn it around and it joins the top and the left, with nothing else.

choice_feedback.A: This straight road can join only one of the two roads, not both.
choice_feedback.B: This piece has 3 road ends, so one road would run off the edge of the map.
choice_feedback.D: This piece has only 1 road end, so it cannot join both roads.
choice_feedback.E: This piece has 4 road ends, so two roads would run off the edge of the map.
